points.statement: Combines spectral decomposition with group-wise attention to restore images degraded by multiple weather types.
points.quote: leverages spectral decomposition and group-wise attention for multi-weather image restoration

points.statement: Global filtering cannot handle highly variable and localized distortions, motivating localized spectral treatment.
points.quote: global filtering methods like direct operations on the frequency domain fail to handle highly variable and localized distortions

points.statement: Splits images into high-frequency edge features via edge detection and low-frequency information through matrix decomposition.
points.quote: decomposes images into high-frequency edge features using conventional edge detection and low-frequency information via Singular Value Decomposition

points.statement: Uses multi-head linear attention to model relationships among the decomposed spectral features.
points.quote: We utilize multi-head linear attention to effectively model the relationship between these features.

points.statement: Integrates fused features with the input to create a grouping mask that clusters regions by spatial similarity and texture.
points.quote: The fused features are integrated with the input to generate a grouping-mask that clusters regions based on the spatial similarity and image texture.

points.statement: Introduces group-wise attention to remove adverse weather effects robustly and keep consistent performance across weather conditions.
points.quote: we introduce a group-wise attention mechanism, enabling robust adverse weather removal and ensuring consistent performance across diverse weather conditions.

points.statement: Combines channel attention and spatial attention to balance feature-wise relationships with spatial dependencies.
points.quote: uses both channel attention and spatial attention, effectively balancing feature-wise relationships and spatial dependencies

points.statement: Applying group-wise attention spatially and across channels helps the model focus on relevant features.
points.quote: These group-wise attention is applied both spatially and across channels, allowing the model to focus on the most relevant features.

points.statement: Takes an input image and extracts edge and low-rank information while preserving spatial details.
points.quote: extracts edge and low-rank information from the input image while preserving spatial details
